walkthrough:
Determine the position of the median for $n = 11$:
$$\text{Position of median} = \frac{11 + 1}{2} = 6\text{th value}$$
$$\text{Median} = 173\text{ cm}$$

Find the positions and values of the lower and upper quartiles:
$$\text{Position of } Q_1 = \frac{11 + 1}{4} = 3\text{rd value} = 168\text{ cm}$$
$$\text{Position of } Q_3 = 3 \times 3 = 9\text{th value} = 181\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the interquartile range:
$$\operatorname{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 181 - 168 = 13\text{ cm}$$

ai_rubric.Finding Medians and Quartiles: Identifies median = 173 cm and evaluates IQR = 181 - 168 = 13 cm.

teacher_walkthrough:
Step 2: Find the median:
$$\text{Rank of median} = \frac{n + 1}{2} = \frac{11 + 1}{2} = 6$$
The 6th value is $173$ cm.
$$\text{Median} = 173\text{ cm}$$

Step 3: Find the quartiles $Q_1$ and $Q_3$:
$$\text{Rank of } Q_1 = \frac{n + 1}{4} = \frac{12}{4} = 3$$
The 3rd value is $Q_1 = 168$ cm.
$$\text{Rank of } Q_3 = \frac{3(n + 1)}{4} = \frac{36}{4} = 9$$
The 9th value is $Q_3 = 181$ cm.

Step 4: Compute the interquartile range:
$$\operatorname{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 181 - 168 = 13\text{ cm}$$

- For Jets: $Q_1 = 167$ cm (3rd value), $Q_3 = 183$ cm (9th value) $\implies \operatorname{IQR} = 183 - 167 = 18$ cm (Range $= 190 - 162 = 28$ cm).

Since $18\text{ cm} > 13\text{ cm}$, the heights of the Jets have a greater spread (or the heights of the Aces have a smaller spread).
